kultivator.guide.chapter.1.desc: Test your root, meditate and awaken into Qi Refining.
kultivator.guide.c1.scroll.title: Open the cultivation scroll
kultivator.guide.c1.scroll.body:
Tap [[key:quick]] (Quick Access) to open the jade scroll; hold it for the Quick Access wheel.
The tablets on the left are 8 sections (keys 1-8): Self, Techniques, Disciples, Sect, World, Immortality, Guide and Settings.
Guide › Encyclopedia sums up the rules; /kultivasi prints your status card in chat.
kultivator.guide.c1.root_test.title: Test your spiritual root
kultivator.guide.c1.root_test.body:
Press the Root Test talisman in the scroll (Self › Status), or type the command below.
An 8-second ceremony reads your elements and root grade. The result is permanent.
Root grade multiplies all cultivation: Trash ×0.6, Low ×0.85, Middle ×1.0, High ×1.3, Heavenly ×1.7.
kultivator.guide.c1.meditate.title: Meditate for the first time
kultivator.guide.c1.meditate.body:
Stand on the ground and press [[key:meditate]].
Meditation stops if you move more than 0.5 blocks, get hurt or attack.
While meditating your qi recovers ×6 and the cultivation bar fills.
kultivator.guide.c1.hud.title: Learn the HUD
kultivator.guide.c1.hud.body:
Bottom left: the dantian orb (qi) with a golden ring, which is your cultivation bar.
Next to it: realm, stage, qi and Stored Qi.
The tracker on the right edge shows your next step (seal "Steps" for the Path tablet, "Guide" for this Guide Book); hold [[key:quick]] to open it again.
F1 or F3 hides the HUD.
kultivator.guide.c1.settings.title: Tune the visuals for your computer
kultivator.guide.c1.settings.body:
Scroll › Settings › Display & Effects: Effect Quality Minimal, Normal or Maximal (Auto drops to Minimal below 40 FPS).
Camera & Film: cinematic camera Full, Short or Off; [[key:skip_scene]] skips a scene.
Rebind keys in Settings › Controls (Change keys…).
kultivator.guide.c1.fill_bar.title: Fill the Mortal bar
kultivator.guide.c1.fill_bar.body:
The Mortal bar needs 60 cultivation.
Kill monsters (max health ×0.5), mine ores (iron 2, diamond 10), eat Golden Carrots (+8) or meditate.
kultivator.guide.c1.awaken.title: Awaken into Qi Refining
kultivator.guide.c1.awaken.body:
When the bar is full, press [[key:meditate]] while meditating, the Breakthrough talisman or the command below.
The 6-second awakening always succeeds; do not move more than 6 blocks.
You learn Cloud Step (jump again in mid-air) and Qi Palm (press [[key:cast]]) at once.
kultivator.guide.c1.jalan.title: Open the Path tablet
kultivator.guide.c1.jalan.body:
The Path tablet holds First Steps, Foundation Trials and Daily Chores.
Each finished First Steps chapter gives a reward (Claim reward talisman).
Daily Chores: three tasks per game day, each worth 4% of your bar.
kultivator.guide.chapter.2.desc: Cultivate faster: sites, spirit veins, spirit stones and formations.
kultivator.guide.c2.stages.title: Stages and the bottleneck
kultivator.guide.c2.stages.body:
Every realm has 4 stages: Early, Middle, Late, Peak. A full bar raises your stage automatically.
At Peak the bar stops (the bottleneck); the overflow becomes Stored Qi and is never lost.
Qi Refining needs 120 / 162 / 204 / 246 cultivation per stage.
kultivator.guide.c2.meditate30.title: Meditate 30 minutes in total
kultivator.guide.c2.meditate30.body:
Meditation is the main source: base rate × site × formation × fuel (at most ×3.5) × qi density.
Closed-door cultivation: +5% every 5 unbroken minutes (max +25%); after 30 minutes the enlightenment chance is ×1.5.
A Moment of Enlightenment (rolled every minute) gives 20% of the bar at once.
kultivator.guide.c2.sites.title: Sit at a spiritual site
kultivator.guide.c2.sites.body:
Mountain peak (Y ≥ 120, open sky) ×1.5 · Cherry Grove ×1.4 · lit Beacon within 8 blocks ×1.5.
≥ 4 Amethyst Blocks or clusters within 4 blocks ×1.3 · The End ×1.6 · full-moon night ×1.5.
Sites stack up to ×4, but the combined meditation cap stays ×3.5.
kultivator.guide.c2.veins.title: Spirit veins: move when they run thin
kultivator.guide.c2.veins.body:
The world is split into 4×4-chunk regions (64×64 blocks) with spirit veins: Great 200%, Rich 140%, normal 100%, Thin 60%.
Meditation drains the density (half as fast below Deity Transformation); below 20% the action bar tells you to move.
Move to another region or use spirit stones; a vein refills fully in about 42 minutes.
The Spirit Vein Compass (compass + Amethyst Shard + Gold Ingot + Glow Berries) points to the nearest Great or Rich vein.
kultivator.guide.c2.stones.title: Spirit stones as fuel
kultivator.guide.c2.stones.body:
From Qi Refining on, mining ores without Silk Touch sometimes drops a Low Spirit Stone (iron 3%, diamond 15%).
Hold a stone in your off-hand while meditating: Low ×1.5 (1 stone/30 s), Mid ×2.0 (150 s), High ×2.5, Supreme ×3.0.
Fuel also halves the vein drain. 9 stones = 1 stone of the next grade.
kultivator.guide.c2.formation1.title: Small Qi Gathering Formation (×1.25)
kultivator.guide.c2.formation1.body:
Sit on a block; place 4 Amethyst Blocks level with your seat, exactly 3 blocks north, south, east and west.
An active formation draws qi lines to your body (checked every 5 seconds).
All vanilla blocks; the mod only reads them.
kultivator.guide.c2.formation2.title: Great Qi Gathering Formation (×1.6)
kultivator.guide.c2.formation2.body:
Add 4 Amethyst Blocks at the corners (3 blocks out, level with the seat) and sit on a Block of Gold.
The Great formation keeps the vein density above 30% and drains ×0.6.
Look at the Block of Gold while holding formation blocks: the Blueprint shows right, empty and wrong slots.
kultivator.guide.c2.formation3.title: Heavenly Star Formation (×2.2)
kultivator.guide.c2.formation3.body:
Great formation + End Rods on top of the four cardinal amethyst blocks (not the corners).
Add a Beacon or Lodestone right under the Block of Gold.
The density never drops below 45% and drains ×0.35. End Rods need chorus fruit from The End: a later goal.
kultivator.guide.c2.peak.title: Reach Qi Refining Peak
kultivator.guide.c2.peak.body:
At Peak a full bar is the bottleneck: ready to break through to Foundation Establishment.
Extra cultivation goes into Stored Qi, which raises the breakthrough chance (max +10%).
kultivator.guide.chapter.3.desc: Breakthrough chance, Preparation and your first pills.
kultivator.guide.c3.prep.title: Open the Preparation coin
kultivator.guide.c3.prep.body:
Status tab → Preparation coin (also in the Breakthrough talisman tooltip), updated while the bar is full at the bottleneck.
It adds up your chance: base 75% · root · pills · Stored Qi · site.
Use it before every big breakthrough: it also sums up the strikes, the Heart Demon and a checklist.
kultivator.guide.c3.chance.title: Raise the breakthrough chance
kultivator.guide.c3.chance.body:
Chance = 75% + root grade (Trash −10% … Heavenly +10%) + pills + site + Stored Qi, at most 98%.
Spiritual site +5%, qi gathering formation +3% per tier.
Foundation Establishment Pill +15%, Nether Star +10%.
kultivator.guide.c3.furnace.title: Refine a pill in the Alchemy Furnace
kultivator.guide.c3.furnace.body:
A cauldron on a lit campfire is an Alchemy Furnace (soul campfire: +10% success).
Right-click the cauldron holding an ingredient to add it; sneak + right-click with an empty hand to refine (10 seconds).
Failure = black smoke and the ingredients are lost. Every recipe is in the Alchemy tablet.
kultivator.guide.c3.pills.title: Pills that help now
kultivator.guide.c3.pills.body:
Foundation Establishment Pill: Golden Carrot + Glowstone Dust + Amethyst Shard + Bone Meal (2 pills), +15% chance.
Qi Gathering Pill: Glowstone Dust + Sugar + Glow Berries (2 pills), +15% of the bar (max 450).
Healing Pill: Glistering Melon Slice + Golden Carrot + Sweet Berries + Kelp, heals 60% health.
kultivator.guide.c3.toxicity.title: Watch your pill toxicity
kultivator.guide.c3.toxicity.body:
Every pill adds pill toxicity (0–100); it drops by 1 every 30 seconds, or every 10 seconds while meditating.
Toxicity weakens pills; above 80 pills make you sick and add Heart Demon pressure.
The Toxin Purging Pill lowers toxicity by 35 × the pill quality.
kultivator.guide.c3.breakthrough.title: Break through to Foundation Establishment
kultivator.guide.c3.breakthrough.body:
At Qi Refining Peak with a full bar: press [[key:meditate]] while meditating, the Breakthrough talisman or the command below.
5 seconds of gathering qi, then the chance roll. Getting hurt or moving > 6 blocks cancels it without a penalty.
Failure: 30% of the bar is lost, about 2.5 minutes of Qi Deviation (cultivation ×0.5), Heart Demon pressure +25.
kultivator.guide.c3.sword.title: Fly on your Flying Sword
kultivator.guide.c3.sword.body:
The Flying Sword opens at Foundation Establishment.
Carry any sword in your inventory, then press [[key:flying_sword]] to mount or dismount.
Flying drains qi every second; recover it with meditation or pills.
kultivator.guide.c3.quality.title: Breakthrough quality
kultivator.guide.c3.quality.body:
Every breakthrough is rated Cracked ×0.9, Normal ×1.0, Perfect ×1.15 or Heavenly ×1.3.
The Awakening from Mortal is always at least Normal. The average multiplies your max health, max qi and cultivation speed.
High health during tribulations, qi formations, Foundation Trials and High or Supreme spirit stones raise it; Strengthen Foundation fixes it later.
kultivator.guide.chapter.4.desc: Your first tribulation, choosing a Dao and getting ready for the Heart Demon.
kultivator.guide.c4.trials.title: Foundation Trials (optional)
kultivator.guide.c4.trials.body:
Path tablet › Trials: three optional trials for every major breakthrough from Golden Core to True Immortal.
Towards Golden Core: 20 technique kills · 20 minutes meditating at a ×1.5+ site · set foot in the Nether.
Each trial +0.07 quality; all three +0.05 more and strikes ×0.9 (Firm Foundation).
kultivator.guide.c4.trib_prep.title: Prepare your first tribulation
kultivator.guide.c4.trib_prep.body:
Foundation → Golden Core calls a Heavenly Tribulation: 3 strikes of 15% max health, the last one doubled (60% in total).
Strikes pierce armour but never kill: a strike that would be lethal makes the tribulation fail instead.
Reducers: Golden Core Pill ×0.85, Tribulation Warding Pill ×0.75, Enchanted Golden Apple ×0.85, an active Protective Formation ×0.85.
kultivator.guide.c4.trib.title: Survive the Golden Core tribulation
kultivator.guide.c4.trib.body:
A 12-second omen, then one strike every 3.5 seconds. The weather does not change, no block is touched.
Stay within 6 blocks of where you started; a knock-back is not fleeing, but > 10 blocks for 3 seconds = failure.
Tribulations in the Nether or the End have their own version (the Nether briefly sets your body on fire).
kultivator.guide.c4.dao.title: Choose your Dao
kultivator.guide.c4.dao.body:
From Golden Core on choose one of 8 Daos, once in your life: Sword, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Body, Life, Shadow & Wind, Space.
Pick it in Self › Root & Dao (the Bagua octagon) or with the command below.
A matching root element makes Dao comprehension ×1.5 (Metal → Sword, Earth → Body, Wood → Life and so on).
kultivator.guide.c4.comprehension.title: Dao comprehension 10%
kultivator.guide.c4.comprehension.body:
Technique damage is multiplied by 1 + comprehension ÷ 100.
Raise it by casting your Dao's techniques at monsters, Dao actions (for Fire: killing burning monsters) and meditating at a matching site.
Tiers: 10% Minor, 30% Major, 60% Perfect, 90% Dao Domain.
kultivator.guide.c4.codex.title: Cast a technique of your Dao
kultivator.guide.c4.codex.body:
Open the Technique Codex with [[key:codex]] or Scroll › Techniques: 168 techniques with their Source, numbers and how to get them.
Put techniques into the Seal Set; [[key:cast]] casts, [[key:next]] selects the next, hold [[key:cast]] for the Seal Wheel.
New techniques come from realms, enchanted books (sneak + use), jade slips and inheritance trials.
kultivator.guide.c4.elite.title: Hunt Demonic Beasts
kultivator.guide.c4.elite.body:
From Qi Refining on, monsters glowing in an element colour sometimes appear: Demonic Beasts (elites).
Elites always drop a Beast Core; a Demon Beast King (tier 3) has a 10% chance of a King Core.
Cores can be refined for cultivation, used as alchemy catalysts or fed to spirit beasts.
kultivator.guide.c4.heart_prep.title: Guard your heart against the Heart Demon
kultivator.guide.c4.heart_prep.body:
You must face a Heart Demon before the tribulations to Nascent Soul, Dao Union and True Immortal.
Heart Demon pressure rises from failed breakthroughs (+25), pill toxicity above 80 and heavy killing; above 100 it can come on its own.
The Heart Calming Pill lowers pressure by 50. Winning = Firm Dao Heart: breakthrough quality +0.1.
kultivator.guide.chapter.5.desc: The Sect Hall Stele, templates and depositing materials.
kultivator.guide.c5.stele.title: Craft a Sect Hall Stele
kultivator.guide.c5.stele.body:
Shaped recipe: G B G / A L A / G B G.
G = Gold Ingot (4), B = Bookshelf (2), A = Block of Amethyst (2), L = Lodestone.
Vanilla Lodestone: 8 Chiseled Stone Bricks + 1 Iron Ingot. The stele recipe unlocks once a Lodestone is in your inventory.
kultivator.guide.c5.place.title: Found your Sect Hall
kultivator.guide.c5.place.body:
Place the stele. For a template later, pick flat Overworld ground away from villages.
Not within 128 blocks of another player's hall; there is no realm requirement.
Right-click the stele to open the hall scroll; rename it with the command below (3–24 letters).
kultivator.guide.c5.template.title: Choose a sect template
kultivator.guide.c5.template.body:
Hall scroll → Build tablet → Choose Template (or the [Choose Sect Template] button in chat).
Nine templates, from the Unranked Sect (25 × 29) to the Heavenly Court (161 × 161); start with Template 1.
View Footprint shows a hologram for 2 minutes; Rotate until the gate faces the way you want.
kultivator.guide.c5.confirm.title: Confirm the footprint
kultivator.guide.c5.confirm.body:
Wait until the footprint is 100% scanned (walk around it) with no red warning.
Red: a village, a world structure in the dug range, too steep, lava or protected blocks. Move if needed.
Tick the consent box, then hold the Confirm seal for 3 seconds. Until the first block is placed, Change Template is free.
kultivator.guide.c5.deposit.title: Deposit materials until Tier 1 is done
kultivator.guide.c5.deposit.body:
Sneak + right-click the stele while holding an accepted material (stone, wood, roof tiles and more).
Or Materials panel → Deposit what is needed, or the command below.
The next building starts by itself once its bill is covered; the HUD shows what is still missing.
Stay within 160 blocks of the stele so construction keeps running.
kultivator.guide.c5.special.title: Special items
kultivator.guide.c5.special.body:
Some materials are deposited 1:1 as themselves: cauldron, smoker, campfire, bookshelf, lectern, brewing stand, lodestone, crying obsidian, amethyst block, bell, barrel, End rod.
Tier 4 needs a soul campfire and a brewing stand (from the Nether: soul sand, blaze rods).
Tier 5 needs 1 lodestone + 4 crying obsidian + 4 amethyst blocks for the formation disc.
kultivator.guide.c5.blocked.title: When construction is blocked
kultivator.guide.c5.blocked.body:
Your own blocks, filled containers and protected blocks are never removed silently: that part waits.
Use [Check again] after moving your things, or [Finish without blocked blocks].
[Skip] does not count as done, so the tier and the Hall Level do not rise.
In single player, alt-tab pauses the game, so construction stops too.
kultivator.guide.c5.move.title: Moving the hall
kultivator.guide.c5.move.body:
Place a second stele, then sneak + right-click with an empty main hand; repeat within 10 seconds.
At most once per game day. With a template a dialog offers [Move & dismantle] / [Move & leave] / [Cancel].
Mining the stele only puts the hall to sleep; its data stays and wakes up when you place it again.
kultivator.guide.chapter.6.desc: Accepting, guiding, teaching and guarding disciples.
kultivator.guide.c6.candidates.title: Wait for Recruitment Day
kultivator.guide.c6.candidates.body:
Every 3 days at dawn, 2–5 candidates come to your stele (more at higher Hall Levels).
You must be online within 128 blocks of the stele that day; missed days do not stack.
Candidates stay until the next dawn. The Candidates tablet shows when the next Recruitment is.
kultivator.guide.c6.test.title: Test the candidates
kultivator.guide.c6.test.body:
Press the Test talisman (1 Amethyst Shard) on a candidate card, or right-click the candidate holding a shard.
A three-step climb and a Duan pillar reveal their root, soul colour, talent and physique.
High Resolve (≥ 70) can still join as a Registered Disciple even with little talent.
kultivator.guide.c6.accept.title: Accept your first disciple
kultivator.guide.c6.accept.body:
Press Accept on the candidate card; the disciple limit is checked first.
Living disciple limit: 5 + Hall Level ÷ 2 (at most 9; +1 for Templates 5–9 after Tier 9).
An Immortal Ascension Token (stronghold or ancient city chests) used on the stele brings a talented candidate at once.
kultivator.guide.c6.screen.title: Open a disciple scroll
kultivator.guide.c6.screen.body:
Right-click your disciple with an empty hand, or press [[key:murid]] (the disciple you look at or the nearest within 64 blocks; press again for the next).
Tabs: Status, Techniques, Orders, Pills & Breakthrough, Talents, Treasures, Path.
Orders: Follow, Stay & Guard, Meditate (cultivation ×1.5), Assist.
kultivator.guide.c6.guidance.title: Master Guidance (Bimbingan Guru)
kultivator.guide.c6.guidance.body:
Meditate near a disciple who is meditating too: within 8 + 2 × your realm blocks (at most 24).
The disciple gets 10% + 3% × your realm + 5% × the realm gap of your meditation cultivation (at most 60%).
The higher your realm, the faster your disciples rise.
kultivator.guide.c6.teach.title: Teach a technique
kultivator.guide.c6.teach.body:
Techniques tab → pick a technique you know → Teach (within 16 blocks).
Qi cost by grade: Yellow 10% … Divine 50% of your max qi; the disciple must meet its realm and Dao.
Prepare puts a technique into the disciple's combat slots. Flying Sword and Cloud Step cannot be taught.
kultivator.guide.c6.gifts.title: Give pills and choose a disciple's Dao
kultivator.guide.c6.gifts.body:
Hold a pill and right-click your disciple: 70% effect, no pill toxicity, one pill of a kind per minute.
When a disciple reaches Golden Core, choose its Dao in the Pills & Breakthrough tab (once in its life).
The bond grows from teaching, pills, meditating together and guarding its breakthroughs.
kultivator.guide.c6.hufa.title: Guard a disciple's breakthrough (Hu Fa)
kultivator.guide.c6.hufa.body:
When a disciple's bar is full at Peak, press Breakthrough in the Pills & Breakthrough tab (within 16 blocks; tribulations need ≥ 50% health).
Hu Fa: meditate or stand still while sneaking within 8 blocks. Strikes ×0.8, quality +0.1, Foundation chance +10%.
Tahan Petir (Hold the Lightning, command below) takes the next strike for the disciple, at most 3 times per trial.
kultivator.guide.c6.disciple_gc.title: A disciple reaches Golden Core
kultivator.guide.c6.disciple_gc.body:
Hall renown only comes from disciples: every disciple breakthrough gives 10 × the target realm number.
A disciple's tribulation never kills it; one that is sure to fail is refused first, with the numbers.
A fallen disciple leaves a Soul Tablet to call it back.
kultivator.guide.c6.destroyer.title: Destroyer Arts and the Oath (optional)
kultivator.guide.c6.destroyer.body:
A disciple who passed the 4th calamity (around ★33) unlocks Destroyer Arts; by default they are block-safe.
Changing real blocks needs three keys: server permission, the Oath of Destruction and Lepaskan Segel (Release Seal) per disciple.
OFF by default. Back up your world first; closing any key stops everything at once.
kultivator.guide.chapter.7.desc: Heart Demons, lightning rings and three hard tribulations.
kultivator.guide.c7.heart.title: Defeat the Heart Demon
kultivator.guide.c7.heart.body:
Before the tribulation to Nascent Soul a Heart Demon comes: 120 seconds, 1.2 × your health, hits as hard as you.
You lose if your health drops below 20% (you do not die). Below 50% when it appears, you are raised to 50%.
Bring your best weapon and armour: its hits are reduced by armour. Winning = full health and 10% of the bar, then the tribulation.
kultivator.guide.c7.rings.title: Lightning rings
kultivator.guide.c7.rings.body:
From the Nascent Soul target on, a 1.5-block ring appears at your feet 1.5 seconds before every strike.
Step out (> 1.5 blocks from its centre) = the strike only grazes you for 40%; one 2-block side step is enough.
Staying inside for every strike = Defy the Heavens: quality +0.12. The tribulation HUD on the left edge guides you.
kultivator.guide.c7.ns.title: Reach Nascent Soul
kultivator.guide.c7.ns.body:
Tribulation: 5 strikes × 16%, the last one doubled. The Dao Protector wave here is only 2 ordinary monsters.
Heal to ≥ 90% health before you start; eat and take pills between strikes.
The Soul Nurturing Pill (+30% of the bar) can only be taken from Nascent Soul on.
kultivator.guide.c7.protectors.title: Dao Protectors and Tribulation Hu Fa
kultivator.guide.c7.protectors.body:
During a tribulation monster waves come (every 3 strikes, at most 10 alive); friends, disciples and spirit beasts help.
/sect brothers can become Tribulation Hu Fa: each one strikes ×0.95 (together at least ×0.85) and quality +0.04.
They join with the [Guard] button or the command below (from at most 64 blocks).
kultivator.guide.c7.talisman.title: Tribulation Ward talismans
kultivator.guide.c7.talisman.body:
Blank Talisman: 3 paper + 1 Spirit Grass + 1 red dye → 3.
Hold the paper in your main hand and a lightning rod in your off-hand, then sneak + use.
During your own tribulation one ward makes the next strike ×0.5 (at most 2 per tribulation). All multipliers together are at least ×0.5.
kultivator.guide.c7.dt.title: Reach Deity Transformation
kultivator.guide.c7.dt.body:
Tribulation: 7 strikes × 17%. From here on every wave brings one Demonic Beast.
The first tribulation to Deity Transformation gives an Inheritance Ice Crystal (the key to the Land of the Ancient God).
The meditation rate jumps (base 4.0 per second), but the vein drain is no longer halved.
kultivator.guide.c7.du.title: Reach Dao Union
kultivator.guide.c7.du.body:
The second Heart Demon comes first, then 9 strikes × 18% (the last 36%): 180% of your health without dodging.
Dodging through the rings, pills and wards make it safe. Preparation tells you how much healing to bring.
A Heart Demon you already beat is not repeated if the tribulation fails.
kultivator.guide.c7.cave.title: Set your Cave Abode
kultivator.guide.c7.cave.body:
Meditate on a Qi Gathering Formation seat inside an active, powered Protective Formation, then run the command below.
Protective Formation: a Lodestone + 4 Crying Obsidian exactly 4 blocks north, south, east, west; sneak + use it with an Amethyst Shard (10 minutes of power) or a spirit stone.
Within 6 blocks of the seat: vein drain ×0.5 and enlightenment +1% per minute.
kultivator.guide.c7.strengthen.title: Strengthen Foundation
kultivator.guide.c7.strengthen.body:
Meditate in a Great or Heavenly Star Qi Gathering Formation, then run the 30-second ritual.
It raises your lowest breakthrough quality (the earliest on ties) and costs 3 × the Peak bar of that realm, not of your current one, in Stored Qi (Golden Core 9,225, Dao Union 184,500).
Cracked → Normal 100%, Normal → Perfect 60%, Perfect → Heavenly 25%; a failure refunds half the cost.
kultivator.guide.chapter.8.desc: Formation Eyes, power, keepers and the strongest formations.
kultivator.guide.c8.eye.title: Craft a Formation Eye
kultivator.guide.c8.eye.body:
Recipe: A S A / G L G / A S A. A = Amethyst Shard, S = Low Spirit Stone, G = Gold Ingot, L = Lodestone.
Place it inside your hall territory. Outside a territory only personal formations work (at most 2, Yellow and Mystic grade).
kultivator.guide.c8.first.title: First formation: K2 Small Spirit Gathering
kultivator.guide.c8.first.body:
Put a Block of Amethyst right under the Formation Eye, then show the pattern with the command below.
Hologram: gold cube = missing block, red cross = wrong block, green = right.
Sneak + right-click the eye with an Amethyst Shard or a spirit stone: Blood Recognition. When complete, the formation is registered.
kultivator.guide.c8.power.title: Power and the Treasury
kultivator.guide.c8.power.body:
Every formation holds 48 hours of power. Yellow and Mystic accept amethyst or spirit stones; Earth and up only spirit stones.
Deposit into the Treasury with the command below; a core with < 2 hours left draws from it by itself.
An idle formation (standby) only pays ×0.25.
kultivator.guide.c8.keeper.title: Assign a formation keeper
kultivator.guide.c8.keeper.body:
Order a disciple to Stay within 3 blocks of a running Formation Eye, or use the command below.
Guard: Yellow and Mystic free, Earth and up ×0.5. Empower: more strength. Vigilant: fights intruders.
The keeper's realm must be high enough: Earth Golden Core, Heaven Nascent Soul, Immortal Deity Transformation.
kultivator.guide.c8.grades.title: Formation grades and slots
kultivator.guide.c8.grades.body:
Yellow (Hall 1), Mystic (Hall 3), Earth (Hall 5), Heaven (Hall 7), Immortal (Hall 9).
Active slots: Hall 1–2: 2, 3–4: 3, 5–6: 4, 7–8: 5, 9: 6. Protective Formations and personal qi seats are free.
The Formation Codex lists the 24 sect formations and their blocks.
kultivator.guide.c8.b5.title: Strongest gatherer: B5 Great Spirit Gathering
kultivator.guide.c8.b5.body:
B5 (Earth, Hall 5): a Block of Gold under the eye, an Amethyst Cluster on top.
Eight towers (3 Amethyst Blocks + an End Rod) at (0,±7), (±7,0), (±5,±5); four jade blocks (prismarine, prismarine bricks, emerald block) at (±3,±3).
The whole territory: gathering ×(1 + 0.20 × P), ×(1 + 0.25 × P) with the eye at Y ≥ 120; vein drain ×0.8.
kultivator.guide.c8.seat.title: A Heavenly Star qi seat in your sect
kultivator.guide.c8.seat.body:
The personal Heavenly Star Formation (×2.2) stays the strongest for your own seat and stacks with sect formations: site × qi formation × spirit stones stop at ×3.5, then the Sect Formation field adds on top of that cap (at most ×1.5).
Template Tier 8 builds a qi seat: Template 3 Small, 4–6 Great, 7–9 Heavenly Star (4 End rods + 1 lodestone).
Sit on that seat inside a Protective Formation, or inside a powered Sect Formation of the Protective or Combined family, to make it your Cave Abode.
kultivator.guide.c8.a1.title: The summit: Ten Thousand Immortals Formation
kultivator.guide.c8.a1.body:
A1 (Immortal, Hall 9, facing north): a Beacon on top of the eye, 8 Smooth Quartz around it, eight trigram pillars with End Rods.
Complete when the Grand Sect Formation is active and three parts run (Taiji, Liangyi, Sixiang).
The hall's other formations get A +0.15 and radius +2; breakthrough quality +0.04.
kultivator.guide.chapter.9.desc: Renown, Hall Levels 1–9, events, raids and vassal villages.
kultivator.guide.c9.renown.title: Reach Hall Level 3
kultivator.guide.c9.renown.body:
Hall Level = the lower of the level your renown allows and your building cap.
Renown 0 / 100 / 300 / 700 / 1,500 / 3,000 / 6,000 / 12,000 / 25,000 for Levels 1–9; it never drops.
Renown only comes from disciples: breakthroughs (10 × target realm), tournaments, expeditions, the Forbidden Ground, bosses, Lost Arts.
kultivator.guide.c9.level5.title: Hall Level 5
kultivator.guide.c9.level5.body:
With a template the building cap = the construction tier. Without one it is scanned: Scripture Pavilion → 4, active Grand Formation → 6, 4 Target blocks → 8, 3 tower rooms → 9.
The Grand Formation must stay powered, or be kept by a Foundation+ disciple within 3 blocks of its Lodestone.
Hall 5 opens Earth-grade formations.
kultivator.guide.c9.tier5.title: Template Tier 5 and late materials
kultivator.guide.c9.tier5.body:
Tier 5 places an inactive Bagua disc: register its lodestone with an Amethyst Shard.
Tier 7 needs a bell (village or toolsmith) and target blocks; Templates 3–9 also a barrel.
Tiers 8/9 need End Rods for the pagoda tips: made from a blaze rod + popped chorus fruit from The End.
kultivator.guide.c9.bulk.title: Gather bulk materials
kultivator.guide.c9.bulk.body:
Bill targets (before excavation credit): Template 1 about 3,240 units … Template 9 about 65,230 units.
Dug earth, stone, wood and flowers pay the bill directly (Use dug materials coin).
Gathering Expeditions and up to 4 disciple Builders (+25% speed each) speed it up.
kultivator.guide.c9.events.title: Sect events
kultivator.guide.c9.events.body:
Expeditions from the Missions tablet: disciples leave for some days and return with items and renown (10 × mission tier).
Tournaments every 7 days (≥ 3 Outer+ disciples, you within 32 blocks): winners 200 / 100 / 50 renown.
The Forbidden Ground every 15 days (Hall 2+), the Hundred Dynasties War every fourth Recruitment Day (Hall 3+).
kultivator.guide.c9.ranks.title: Sect ranks
kultivator.guide.c9.ranks.body:
Ranks tablet: Registered → Outer → Inner → Core → Elder → Grand Elder, with Contribution Points and realm.
Rank multiplies a disciple's cultivation (Registered ×0.55 … Grand Elder ×1.0).
A Sect Protector (Dao Union or ★1) can be ordered to Guard the Hall.
kultivator.guide.c9.raids.title: Face the Demonic Sect raids
kultivator.guide.c9.raids.body:
From Hall 3, every 9 days a Demonic Sect raids at night; the omen comes at the sunset before.
3–5 waves march to the stele; raiders within 6 blocks fill the Plunder Seal. 100 = plundered (never blocks or disciples).
Be in your territory and not AFK; sect formations, guard disciples and the Grand Formation help.
kultivator.guide.c9.vassal.title: Vassal villages
kultivator.guide.c9.vassal.body:
Sect Patron Plaque: S B S / G S G / L _ L (S = Stone Bricks, B = any banner, G = Gold Ingot, L = Low Spirit Stone).
Place it ≤ 24 blocks from a village bell, Hall 2+, ≤ 256 blocks from the stele. Survive 3 waves the next night.
Loyal villages pay tribute every 3 days and send candidates; at most 1 + Hall Level ÷ 3 villages.
kultivator.guide.c9.storage.title: Sect storage
kultivator.guide.c9.storage.body:
Sect Storehouse: nine materials, up to 1,000,000 units each; the overflow goes to the Dig Chest.
The Dig Chest keeps dug items (ores, gems, metal) without limit; take them in the Salvage panel.
The Sect Granary (27 slots) is filled by duties, expeditions and tribute; its overflow now goes to the Dig Chest.
kultivator.guide.c9.level9.title: A Sect Under Heaven: Hall Level 9
kultivator.guide.c9.level9.body:
Needs 25,000 renown and building cap 9 (template Tier 9 or 3 Blazing Sky Tower rooms).
Level 9: 5 candidates per arrival, disciple limit 9, territory radius 56, pavilion prices ×0.80.
Finish the whole template for the Complete Sect achievement.
kultivator.guide.chapter.10.desc: Nine layers, boons and fair tribulations.
kultivator.guide.c10.enter.title: Enter Immortal Ascension
kultivator.guide.c10.enter.body:
From Dao Union Peak: 10 strikes × 19%. From this target on every 4th strike has twin rings: standing in either one is a full hit.
Immortal Ascension has 9 layers of 4 stages each: this is the longest grind.
Every layer tribulation gives a Heavenly Tomb Sigil.
kultivator.guide.c10.caps.title: Fair tribulations
kultivator.guide.c10.caps.body:
Immortal Ascension and True Immortal targets: all strikes together are at most 2.2 × max health (before dodging and multipliers), the last ×1.5.
Every strike you dodge through a ring heals 6% of your max health.
Example: layer 5 = 14 × 15.2%. At most 10 Dao Protectors are alive at once.
kultivator.guide.c10.boons.title: Boons per layer
kultivator.guide.c10.boons.body:
1 Immortal Breath · 2 Light Step · 3 Jade Skin · 4 Qi Sea (max qi ×1.15) · 5 Heaven's Reach (reach +1.5).
6 Immortal Meridians (qi recovery ×1.25) · 7 Unbroken Soul (survive a killing blow once a day) · 8 Clear Mind · 9 Door of Immortality (True Immortal strikes ×0.85).
kultivator.guide.c10.speed.title: Speed up meditation
kultivator.guide.c10.speed.body:
One Early stage takes about 50 minutes unaided; about 5–10 minutes with every bonus.
Combine: Heavenly Star Formation, a spiritual site, a spirit stone in your off-hand, your Cave Abode, a Great or Rich vein, closed-door cultivation.
The Enlightenment Pill (enlightenment chance ×2) helps; the Immortal Pill gives exactly 1 bar.
kultivator.guide.c10.tomb.title: The Heavenly Tomb
kultivator.guide.c10.tomb.body:
A Heavenly Tomb Sigil opens the Heavenly Tomb (Immortal Ascension+), one sigil per descent.
Each layer gives 1 + layer ÷ 9 Tomb Energy Essence: you need 9 to ascend to the Immortal Realm later.
A new record at layers 9, 18, 27… gives a Supreme Spirit Stone, a King Core and a sigil.
kultivator.guide.c10.layer5.title: Immortal Ascension layer 5
kultivator.guide.c10.layer5.body:
Layer 5–9 tribulations are the hardest wall: come with ≥ 90% health, pills and wards.
Each layer's Foundation Trials (Path tablet) give quality and Firm Foundation (strikes ×0.9).
Bring sect brothers as Tribulation Hu Fa and dodge every ring.
Every Immortal Ascension layer adds to your techniques' power against trial foes (+0.25 to the base power per layer). Layer 8 unlocks no new technique: use it to master your layer-7 techniques fully.
kultivator.guide.c10.layer9.title: Immortal Ascension layer 9 Peak
kultivator.guide.c10.layer9.body:
At layer 9 Peak the next tribulation takes you to True Immortal: the third Heart Demon and 18 strikes.
The Door of Immortality boon makes its strikes ×0.85.
Hold High or Supreme spirit stones in your off-hand while breaking through: quality +0.03 / +0.08 per stone (max +0.16).
kultivator.guide.chapter.11.desc: The Heavens Acknowledge, Immortal Stars, the Immortal Realm and Heaven's Decree.
kultivator.guide.c11.ti.title: Become a True Immortal
kultivator.guide.c11.ti.body:
The third Heart Demon, then 18 strikes (together at most 2.2 × your health, the last ×1.5).
Dodge through the rings: every dodged strike heals 6% of your health.
Stay within 6 blocks; a knock-back is not fleeing unless you stay > 10 blocks away for 3 seconds.
kultivator.guide.c11.acknowledged.title: The Heavens Acknowledge
kultivator.guide.c11.acknowledged.body:
A few seconds after the tribulation the heavens hold the ceremony The Heavens Acknowledge (30 seconds), only once.
Leaving, dying or changing dimension only cancels it without a penalty; it starts again.
Gifts: immune to Qi Deviation, heal 1 health every 5 seconds, and a rainbow aura.
kultivator.guide.c11.peak.title: True Immortal Peak
kultivator.guide.c11.peak.body:
True Immortal needs 250,000 / 337,500 / 425,000 / 512,500 cultivation per stage.
At Peak the realm path is complete: all cultivation becomes Immortal Qi for Immortal Stars.
kultivator.guide.c11.stars.title: Condense Immortal Stars
kultivator.guide.c11.stars.body:
At Dewa Abadi Peak surplus cultivation becomes Stored Qi (Immortal Qi); condensing it makes one star ★. Star n costs 500,000 × 1.07^(n−1) Immortal Qi (at most 5 billion). No limit on the count.
Every star: +2 max health and +1% max qi, and your techniques ×(1 + 4% per star), a further ×1.15 every 9 stars. A disciple's star gives +4 health and +0.6 attack because disciples do not cast techniques the way you do; the cost curve is the same.
★9 and ★18 open Heaven Gates I and II (Dewa-grade techniques); a Star Calamity holds certain stars until you pass it. Condense with the command below or the Condense Star talisman on the Status tab (Shift + click = all).
kultivator.guide.c11.calamity.title: The first Star Calamity
kultivator.guide.c11.calamity.body:
Calamity 1 holds star ★6, ★7 or ★8 (by your breakthrough quality).
7 strikes (the last ×1.5) and envoy waves; dodge the lightning rings (a grazed strike heals 6% health) and Hu Fa may join; 3 Heaven Seal Shards make the strikes ×0.85.
Failure: a Calamity Wound, no star, and 50% of the cost back.
kultivator.guide.c11.nine.title: Nine Stars
kultivator.guide.c11.nine.body:
★9 opens Divine Gate I for your own technique learning (★18 Divine Gate II).
★9 is also required to ascend to the Immortal Realm.
kultivator.guide.c11.ascend.title: Ascend to the Immortal Realm
kultivator.guide.c11.ascend.body:
Requires: True Immortal Peak, ★9+, already acknowledged by the heavens, not Peaceful, unhurt for 10 seconds. Offering: 9 Tomb Energy Essence + 1 Supreme Spirit Stone.
Ritual: 9 strikes, 2 envoy waves, then 15 seconds of the Black Hole (stay inside the 8-block circle).
Failure: an Ascension Wound and a 1-game-day wait, but the whole offering is refunded.
Success: 1 Realm Crossing Talisman, 16 Immortal Origin Stones, and your Inner World is born.
kultivator.guide.c11.titah.title: The Heaven's Decree Seal
kultivator.guide.c11.titah.body:
After the first calamity, the Wrath of Heaven can descend at dusk: defeat the Heavenly General in the Duel of Will.
The first victory gives the Heaven's Decree Seal; or craft 6 Heaven Seal Shards + 2 Immortal Origin Stones + 1 Soul Seal Jade.
Right-click casts a decree, sneak + right-click opens its menu. Without Destruction Mode every decree is visual only.
kultivator.guide.chapter.12.desc: Small things that save many hours.
kultivator.guide.c12.veins.title: Do not sit on a drained vein
kultivator.guide.c12.veins.body:
When the action bar says "The spirit vein here is running dry", move to another region or use spirit stones.
Great (200%) and Rich (140%) veins are best; find them with the Spirit Vein Compass.
kultivator.guide.c12.health.title: Do not start a tribulation on low health
kultivator.guide.c12.health.body:
Breakthrough quality counts your lowest health during the tribulation.
Preparation checklist: health ≥ 90%, healing, a Tribulation Warding Pill or wards, pill toxicity < 80%, no Qi Deviation.
kultivator.guide.c12.flee.title: Do not run far during a tribulation
kultivator.guide.c12.flee.body:
More than 10 blocks for 3 seconds or changing dimension = failure. Leaving the world or dying after the first strike fails too.
The small map on the tribulation HUD marks the 6-block limit.
kultivator.guide.c12.pills.title: Do not stack pills
kultivator.guide.c12.pills.body:
Pill potency falls with toxicity: 25 → 89%, 50 → 67%, 80 → 30%.
Above 90 every pill has a 25% chance to Backfire (a light Qi Deviation).
kultivator.guide.c12.presence.title: Be there for your sect
kultivator.guide.c12.presence.body:
Candidates only come if you are online within 128 blocks of the stele at dawn.
Construction only runs within 160 blocks; alt-tab pauses the game in single player.
Raids are only fought live while you are in your territory and not AFK.
kultivator.guide.c12.stones.title: Keep High and Supreme stones
kultivator.guide.c12.stones.body:
High and Supreme stones are not burned at the bottleneck; they are kept for Stones at the Bottleneck.
Stones at the Bottleneck are only used up when the breakthrough succeeds.
kultivator.guide.c12.kehancuran.title: Destruction Mode is off by default
kultivator.guide.c12.kehancuran.body:
Without Destruction Mode every technique, decree and event is visual only: your blocks are safe.
If you want to split the earth, back up your world first. /kultivasi kehancuran pulihkan restores blocks within the restore window.
kultivator.guide.c12.hardcore.title: Hardcore is optional
kultivator.guide.c12.hardcore.body:
Hardcore mode is off by default. When on, a failed breakthrough drops you one realm instead of a Qi Deviation.
Turn it on only when you are ready, with /kultivasi hardcore on.
kultivator.guide.c12.help.title: When in doubt
kultivator.guide.c12.help.body:
This Guide Book: Scroll › Guide, the Guide Book slice of the Quick Access wheel (hold [[key:quick]]), or /kultivasi panduan.
Guide › Encyclopedia and the Path tablet explain the rules too. Full guide: docs/PANDUAN.md.
The current chapter follows your realm: Optional steps and steps you tick yourself never hold it, and a sect chapter only becomes current once your Sect Hall Stele stands.
